description: Exactly ONE pixel art fishing-game dialog panel frame, front view, filling the whole canvas edge to edge with no empty margin. Same hand-placed chunky pixel art style as the reference: crisp 1px dark outline, brown double wooden frame, small gold leaf corner ornaments, flat shading with only 3 tones per material, no wood grain noise, no dithering, no gradients. Inside: a teal blue header bar attached to the top inner edge with a thin gold trim, empty. Below it a cream parchment area, and at the bottom a dark navy inset strip. All areas empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no characters, no fish, no progress bar.
color_palette: wood brown, gold, teal blue, cream parchment, dark navy
